title: Coconut Curry Chicken Pot
seoTitle: Coconut Curry Chicken Pot | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: One-pot chicken with coconut milk, sweet potato, and spinach
subtitle: One-pot chicken with coconut milk, sweet potato, and spinach
description: Chicken thighs simmer in coconut milk with red curry paste, sweet potato, and spinach until the broth is fragrant and slightly thick.

steps.title: Brown chicken
steps.instruction: Sear cubed thighs in oil over medium-high 8–10 minutes until golden on edges. Work in batches so meat browns, not steams in its own liquid.

steps.title: Sweat aromatics and curry
steps.instruction: Add onion, cook 4 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, and curry paste. Cook 2 minutes until paste smells fragrant and oil turns reddish.

steps.title: Simmer with coconut milk
steps.instruction: Add sweet potato, coconut milk, broth, and fish sauce. Simmer 20–25 minutes until potato pierces easily and chicken is tender throughout.

steps.title: Wilt spinach
steps.instruction: Remove from heat, stir in spinach until wilted and deep green. Curry should look creamy with visible orange oil droplets on surface.

steps.title: Finish with lime
steps.instruction: Stir in lime juice. Taste and adjust salt. Sauce should balance rich, spicy, and bright—not flat or overly sweet.

proTips: Offer jasmine rice for soaking up curry—crew will want it.
Yellow curry paste swap works for milder heat.
Leftover curry thickens—add broth when reheating.
leftovers: Curry over rice noodles next day.
Freeze portions without spinach; add fresh greens when reheating.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Bold flavor without deep frying. One pot feeds eight and improves as it rests.
mealPrepNotes: Dice sweet potato uniform for even cooking. Open coconut milk cans before starting. Station: Brown thighs first for depth—poaching alone makes flat flavor. Station: Simmer gently after adding coconut milk—boiling splits the fat. Station: Stir spinach in off heat so it stays bright green at service.
